# ring atoms of naphthyridine
ring = [1,2,3,4,19,20,5,6,7,18]
pts = C[ring]; cen = pts.mean(0)
u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(pts-cen)
nrm = vt[2]

n1 = (N18-Ru)/np.linalg.norm(N18-Ru)
p1 = (C[9]-Ru)/np.linalg.norm(C[9]-Ru)
m1 = np.cross(n1,p1); m1 /= np.linalg.norm(m1)
# choose sign pointing away from ring centroid
if np.dot(m1, cen-Ru) > 0: m1 = -m1

# N=C direction: bend 125 deg at N, tilted away from chelate
